summary: Frontend-only test of (1) the search box in shadcn Select (SEARCH_MIN=5), (2) native <select> replaced by NSelect, (3) the Dashboard redesign. Tested on TEST_SCREEN Srl with 6 TEST_I98 clients and 1 TEST_I98 supplier created through the API, then cleaned up. What works: the search box shows on lists with 5 or more options and is autofocused. It does not show on lists with fewer than 5 (bilancio-livello: 3, chiusura-anno: 2, magazzino filter: 1). Filtering ignores case and accents ('ALFA' finds 'TEST_I98 Àlfa') and matches on value/code ('05.01'). Escape closes the select but not the surrounding dialog. Picking a filtered option sets the value. Empty-string options ('Tutte le categorie', 'Nessuna detrazione', 'Nessuna', 'Ordinaria') can be selected and save as ''. Persistence checked: Prima nota registration with ContoSelect + party select (saved, shown in the journal and the balance sheet), ParametriTab contropartita (saved, still there after reload, then reverted), party-pagamento-modalita MP01 then '', party-gestione-iva reverse_charge (checked via API), Bilancio livello numeric (6 rows down to 2), invoice-bonus-select (causale shows / hides), invoice client select on mobile. Dashboard: 10 tiles in 5 columns at 230x159 on 1920px, 2 columns on 390px, no horizontal overflow; vivid colours; status pills; KPI cards coloured; dashboard-panels is a 2-column grid with coloured top borders, max-height 26rem and internal scroll; Personalizza (hide, drag, save, persist after reload, Ripristina) works. I found and fixed 2 regressions in the shared components.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER. The search text stayed when the dropdown was reopened. Radix keeps SelectContent mounted while closed, so the q state survived and on reopen only the previously filtered options were shown (for example, after filtering 'iva' in ct-categoria, 'Tutte le categorie' was hidden). Fix: SelectSearch calls setQ('') on mount. Checked: reopening now shows an empty search and all options, including after Escape.

FIXED BY TESTER. Every NSelect whose className contained 'block' (giornale-origine, bilancio-livello, mastrino-party-select, ParametriTab Opt, ContiTab, TabellaTab, RateoBox, EstrattoCarte, PartyDialog, InvoiceEditor, etc.) got display:block from tailwind-merge instead of flex, so the chevron dropped below the text and overflowed the 36px button (svgTop=29). Fix: added 'flex' after className in cn(). Checked: svgTop=10.

design_issues.screen: Filter selects (Magazzino movimenti-article-filter, Codici tributo ct-categoria, ...)
issues: NSelect triggers inherit w-full from SelectTrigger, so filters that used to size to their content as native selects now stretch to the full row width (1200-1378px) and ct-categoria wraps under the search box. Suggest a default of 'w-auto' (or min-w) in NSelect when className has no w-* class.

Search does not match optgroup labels: typing 'crediti clienti' in ContoSelect finds nothing because only items are matched, not the group label '05 Crediti'. Group labels also stay visible when all their items are filtered out.
There is no 'Nessun risultato' empty state: when nothing matches, the list is blank (or shows only group labels).
Arrow keys and Enter are stopped inside the search input (stopPropagation), so you cannot pick the first match with the keyboard after typing; you have to use the mouse or Tab.
White text on amber-500 (Magazzino tile) and orange-500 (Pagamenti fornitori tile, kpi-iva) has low contrast, about 2.1-2.8:1. Use amber-600/orange-600 or darker text.

The dash-grid uses align-items:start in a 2-column grid without masonry, so there are big vertical gaps under short panels next to tall ones (for example, under 'Scadenze per cliente' beside 'Cruscotto fatture inviate').
OrdiniPanel renders 2 sub-cards inside one grid cell, so one coloured top border spans both.

action_items: Review and keep the 2 tester fixes in ui/select.jsx (reset search on open) and ui/nselect.jsx ('flex' after className)
NSelect: do not force full width on filter selects (default w-auto unless a width class is given)
Select search: also match SelectLabel/optgroup text (or hide empty groups) and add a 'Nessun risultato' row; allow ArrowDown/Enter from the search input to move to / pick the first match
Dashboard: raise contrast on the amber/orange tiles and the IVA KPI; optionally reduce the vertical gaps in dash-grid
critical_code_review_comments: nselect.jsx toItems uses React.Children.toArray, which does not flatten <></> fragments: options wrapped in a fragment are silently dropped. None found in current usages, but this is fragile.
An NSelect value that matches no option (stale ids, null without an empty option) renders a blank trigger instead of the placeholder, because enc(null) becomes '__vuoto__' rather than undefined.
countItems relies on displayName==='SelectItem'. Custom wrappers around SelectItem are not counted, so their lists will never get a search box.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all requested flows pass after the 2 tester fixes; remaining items are design)
